A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 25 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-frustration-PC-Errata-2018-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Frustration (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): The game text changes: “non-Interrupt” becomes “non- Interrupt”; “a card of that title” becomes “target”; “lose a card of that title from hand” becomes “it is lost”; “possible).” becomes “still in hand).”. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (350 × 490 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
